title: Editor Shader Include Debugger: Incorrect type error when using Canvas Item built-ins
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.arch_linux
v.4.0.stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable unknown - Arch Linux ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 01 Nov 2024 03:30:35 +0000 - Wayland - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 3000 (SNB GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-2670QM CPU @ 2.20GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

By default, shader include type is *spatial*, which change the type of *built-ins*
![Screenshot_20241106_133627](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e234427e-7bf8-481e-80e0-b6a442f8812e)
However, it is not possible to change the *shader_type* of shader include file.
![Screenshot_20241106_133604](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e02f5f8-a815-430f-ae87-58ad6e38893f)

The shader does complie with no error and works correctly. But still show as an error in the editor:
![Screenshot_20241106_190958](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/568806ae-1054-4ffe-be80-7f86555cc9f3)

### Steps to reproduce

Create a shader include file.
Try to use some canvas-item built-in.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[shaderincludeissue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17646895/shaderincludeissue.zip)
